tools.name: propbank_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a lemma and every alternate of it in PropBank (at most 20 per call).

language is "en" or "zh". Returns Markdown: per lemma, every roleset with its roles and all
its examples (the sentence, then each argument; traces such as *T*-1 are PropBank's own),
or "not in PropBank". Lemmas over the limit are not looked up: the last line names them
(call again with them). There is no PropBank for another language (Uzbek): nothing.

messages.content:
## Input

Language: en

(none)

1	Edmund Pope tasted freedom today for the first time in more than eight months .

Its graph:

I treated "for the first time in more than eight months" as an ordinal: first (value 1) within a range of "more than eight months".

# ::snt 1
# sentence level graph:
(s1t / taste-01
    :ARG0 (s1p / person
        :wiki "Edmond_Pope"
        :name (s1n / name :op1 "Edmund" :op2 "Pope"))
    :ARG1 (s1f / free-04
        :ARG1 s1p
        :aspect state)
    :temporal (s1t2 / today)
    :ord (s1o / ordinal-entity
        :value 1
        :range (s1m / more-than
            :op1 (s1t3 / temporal-quantity
                :quant 8
                :unit (s1m2 / month))))
    :aspect performance)

content.text:
I annotated this first sentence of the document using its existing graph, so there was nothing earlier to link to.

- **Time:** "today" (`s1t2`) is a relative time expression, so its parent is the document creation time. The tasting (`s1t`) is a completed event that happened today, so it is placed inside `s1t2`. The freedom (`s1f`) is a state that holds while he tastes it, so it overlaps `s1t`. I gave the "more than eight months" quantity no time relation, because it only bounds the ordinal ("first time in…") and is not a time reference.
- **Modality:** The author states both events outright, so both are `full-affirmative` from the author.
- **Coreference:** This is the first sentence, so there are no earlier mentions and the group is empty.

I didn't look up `taste-01` or `free-04` in PropBank. The graph already marks `free-04` as a state, and that is what the overlap relation depends on.

    # document level relations:
    (d / document
        :temporal ((document-creation-time :depends-on s1t2)
                   (s1t2 :contained s1t)
                   (s1t :overlap s1f))
        :modal ((root :modal author)
                (author :full-affirmative s1t)
                (author :full-affirmative s1f)))
